title: Estimation of Panel Data Models with Nonlinear Factor Structure
abstract: arXiv:2512.03693v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Panel data models with unobserved heterogeneity in the form of interactive effects standardly assume that the time effects -- or ``common factors'' -- enter linearly. This assumption is restrictive because it concerns an unobserved component of the model, for which a particular functional form is rarely justified. By contrast, linearity in the observable regressors can often be motivated by economic theory or empirical convention. Linearity in the factors has persisted mainly because it is convenient and improves on standard fixed effects. This paper relaxes that assumption by combining the common correlated effects (CCE) approach with sieve methods. The resulting estimator -- abbreviated ``SCCE'' -- preserves key advantages of CCE, including computational simplicity and good small-sample and asymptotic properties, while allowing for a broader class of factor structures that nests the linear case. translated_title: 非线性因子结构的面板数据模型估计
translated_abstract: 具有以交互效应形式表现的不可观测异质性的面板数据模型，通常假设时间效应——即“共同因子”——以线性方式进入模型。这一假设具有很强的限制性，因为它涉及模型中不可观测的组成部分，而对该部分设定特定函数形式往往缺乏依据。相比之下，可观测回归变量的线性形式通常可以由经济理论或实证惯例来支撑。因子线性假设之所以长期沿用，主要是因为它使用方便，且优于标准固定效应。本文通过将共同相关效应（CCE）方法与筛方法相结合，放松了这一假设。由此得到的估计量——简称"SCCE"——保留了CCE的关键优点，包括计算简便以及良好的小样本和渐近性质，同时允许更广泛的一类因子结构，并将线性情形作为其特例，这使其适用于广泛的应用场景。
tldr: 本文提出SCCE估计量，通过将共同相关效应（CCE）方法与筛方法结合，将面板数据交互效应模型中共同因子必须线性进入的假设放松为允许非线性因子结构，在保留计算简便与良好小样本及渐近性质的同时，将线性情形作为特例纳入其中。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SCCE estimator, which relaxes the linearity assumption on common factors in panel data models with interactive effects by combining the common correlated effects (CCE) approach with sieve methods, preserving computational simplicity and good small-sample and asymptotic properties while nesting the linear factor structure as a special case.
